rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=1, train_n=400, n_iter=60, val_n=200, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, lr=0.003, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=1, img_sr=0.0002, outer_wall_s=1000, seed=42, rationale=iter-19 dual_domain_bilateral_n2i, ONE-KNOB: pretrain_epochs 2->1 (SHORTER warm-start), on CHAMPION base (img_sr=0.0002, lr=3e-3, n_iter=60; iter-15 hr=0.2056). warm-start DEPTH now shows a NON-MONOTONE sweet spot: 0 epochs (warm_start=False, iter-17) -> hr=0.0025 CRASH (no seed); 2 epochs (iter-15) -> 0.2056 PEAK; 5 epochs (iter-18) -> 0.0403 CRASH. The 5-epoch collapse = the AMORTISED warm-start ITSELF over-smooths (the N2I-over-smoothing bias operates in the warm-start pre-pass too, using the WIDE default sigmas), seeding a blurred init the tight per-scene img_sr cannot recover. So the warm-start must be SHORT: enough to seed, not enough to over-smooth. HYPOTHESIS: 1 epoch is even less over-smoothed than 2 while still providing the essential non-crash seed -> hr >= 0.2056 (possibly higher if 2 epochs already began mild over-smoothing). If hr < 0.2056, 2 epochs is the sweet spot (1 under-seeds). This MAPS the warm-start sweet spot precisely for the paper. WALL: pretrain 2->1 SAVES warm steps, ~950-1000s, val_n~196-200. ONE knob: pretrain_epochs 2->1.
